caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chair with a woven seat positioned at a three-quarter angle. The chair has a light brown wooden frame, with turned legs and horizontal stretchers connecting the legs on all four sides for support. The arms are also made of wood and attach to the upper front legs, extending horizontally to connect with the backrest. The backrest consists of three horizontal, slightly curved slats made of wood, evenly spaced along the height of the back, supported by two vertical posts. The seat is composed of a tightly woven straw or rush material in a yellowish-tan color. The composition is centered on a plain, light beige background, with no other objects or decorations visible.
title: Chair
